report_title: FinGuard Phase 4B — Automated Prototype Regression Test Report

tests.name: test_prototype_model_file_exists
tests.description: Assert that behavioural_xgboost.json exists in kaggle_prototype directory

tests.name: test_feature_catalog_file_exists
tests.description: Assert that feature_columns.json exists in kaggle_prototype directory

tests.name: test_feature_catalog_structure
tests.description: Assert feature_columns.json contains valid behavioural and baseline catalogs

tests.name: test_booster_loading_and_architecture
tests.description: Assert that native XGBoost booster loads with 700 trees and 397 features

tests.name: test_exact_feature_count
tests.description: Feature catalog must have exactly 397 features

tests.name: test_baseline_features_prefix
tests.description: First 10 features must match canonical IEEE-CIS transaction ordering

tests.name: test_behavioural_features_tail_ordering
tests.description: The 5 engineered behavioural features must be positioned at indices 392 through 396

tests.name: test_feature_pipeline_output_alignment
tests.description: Pipeline output must produce identical column names and ordering as the 397-feature catalog

tests.name: test_card_key_fully_populated
tests.description: Card key with all fields present must concatenate with underscore delimiter

tests.name: test_card_key_with_missing_values
tests.description: Missing card fields must convert to 'nan' string and avoid propagating nullable NA

tests.name: test_card_key_grouping_consistency
tests.description: Transactions sharing identical card profiles with nulls must group together without dropping

test_suite_results.description: Behavioural feature causality and cold starts

tests.name: test_strict_temporal_causality_and_cold_starts
tests.description: Verify that Tx1 starts at count=0/prior_mean=NaN, Tx2/Tx3 compute strictly prior means, and Card B does not contaminate Card A

tests.name: test_amount_deviation_computation
tests.description: Verify signed relative deviation: (amt - prior_mean) / abs(prior_mean) for spikes, drops, and exact matches

tests.name: test_amount_deviation_cold_start_nan
tests.description: When prior_amount_mean is NaN, amount_deviation must also evaluate to NaN

tests.name: test_amount_deviation_xgboost_nan_routing
tests.description: Verify that XGBoost native inference handles NaN in amount_deviation without error

tests.name: test_score_scaling_and_rounding
tests.description: Probability in [0, 1] must scale linearly to [0, 100] with 1 decimal precision

tests.name: test_monotonicity
tests.description: Risk scores must be strictly non-decreasing with increasing probabilities

tests.name: test_severity_classification_thresholds
tests.description: Verify FinGuard classification boundaries (HIGH >= 75.0, MEDIUM 40.0-74.9, LOW < 40.0)

tests.name: test_explanation_document_base_structure
tests.description: Explanation output must contain base_value (float) and top_factors (list of 5 items)

tests.name: test_top_factor_subdocument_schema
tests.description: Every item in top_factors must adhere to Spring Boot TopFactor entity fields (feature, value, shap_value, impact, description)

tests.name: test_shap_impact_sign_consistency
tests.description: SHAP impact direction must strictly match the mathematical sign of shap_value (positive: INCREASES_RISK, negative: DECREASES_RISK)

tests.name: test_positive_and_negative_drivers_partitioning
tests.description: Verify that SHAP factors can be cleanly partitioned into positive_drivers and negative_drivers matching Spring Boot Explanation.java
